title: Add landlordConsent field to properties schema
description: Critical missing field: REQUIREMENTS.md v1.7 section 10.5 specifies landlordConsent badge system. Field exists in mock data (src/lib/data.ts) but NOT in database schema (src/db/schema/properties.ts). Add boolean field to properties table to track landlord approval status.

title: Implement property management company integration
description: New requirement: Auto-send leftover items agreement (残置物同意書) to property management company after buyer acceptance. Integration via email or API. Prevents accidental disposal by cleaning staff.

title: Implement payment system integration (Stripe or alternative)
description: Phase 1 requirement: Integrate payment processing for 引越し費用 (handover fees). Needs Stripe integration, payment UI, server actions, and database schema for transactions.

title: Audit requirements: Check REQUIREMENTS.md and BUSINESS.md for new features
description: Recurring task: Review REQUIREMENTS.md v1.7 and BUSINESS.md, compare with implementation, create tasks for gaps. Run monthly or when requirements are updated.

title: Add estimatedDuration field to properties schema
description: REQUIREMENTS.md section 7.1 Property model requires estimatedDuration field (e.g., '2〜4ヶ月'). Currently missing from properties schema. Add varchar field to store contract duration estimate.

title: Integrate inquiry-list component into seller dashboard
description: TD-004: inquiry-list.tsx component exists but is unused. Add inquiry management tab to /listing page for sellers to view and manage inquiries.

title: 「クリエイター」を「前の住人」に修正
description: UI上で「クリエイター」という用語がまだ使われている箇所を「前の住人」に統一する。用語ガイドラインに従い、ユーザー向け表示では「前の住人」を使用する。

title: Generate database migrations with drizzle-kit
description: Run drizzle-kit generate to create migration files from schema. Migrations directory is empty but schema is fully defined.

title: Generate PDF for leftover items agreement
description: Technical implementation: Auto-generate 残置物合意書 PDF from furniture list data. Include: furniture list with photos, condition, prices, liability terms, digital signature area. Consider jsPDF or PDFKit.

title: Add recommended spots feature to property listings
description: REQUIREMENTS.md section 10.4 design guidelines mention おすすめスポットタグ (recommended spots tags). Add database field and UI components to display nearby recommended locations with visual borders.

title: Implement image optimization
description: TD-003: Add image optimization using Next.js Image component or WebP conversion. Currently using standard img tags.

title: Implement AI service for estimate calculations
description: estimate-service.ts has TODO for Claude API integration. Implement AI-powered handover fee estimation.

title: Update exit timing field to 退去（引き渡し）希望時期
description: UX update: Rename 引き継ぎ可能期間 field to 退去（引き渡し）希望時期 with auto-disclaimer about cleaning schedule variance. Better reflects actual use case.

title: Add furniture listing strategy to property registration
description: New UX requirement: Update listing creation flow to include detailed furniture list with photos upfront (not just at viewing). Add disclaimer about final agreement at viewing. Hybrid approach for better matching.

title: Design cancellation penalty system
description: New requirement from cancellation-penalty-notes.md: Design penalty system for cancellations after handover agreement. Consider: timing (when penalty applies), amount (fixed vs variable), exceptions, payment method. Requires market research and legal review first.

title: Make phone number field mandatory in email signup form
description:
Simplify signup form:
- Remove social sign-in options (Google, Facebook, etc.)
- Keep only email and phone number fields
- Phone number: mandatory
- Email: optional
- UI: update required field indicators and validation messages

title: Design and implement post-viewing handover agreement flow
description: New requirement from BUSINESS.md: Implement two-stage flow after viewing: 1) Web-based promise confirmation (seller lists furniture, buyer accepts) 2) Generate leftover items agreement (残置物同意書) for property management. Includes email notifications, photo uploads, PDF generation.

title: Add phone number capture to signup form
description: TODO exists in custom-signup-dialog.tsx. Phone field is in User schema but not captured during signup.

title: Add amenities array to properties schema
description: REQUIREMENTS.md design guidelines mention amenity icons with pill layout. Add amenities array field to properties schema to store property amenities (e.g., WiFi, AC, washing machine).

title: Implement furniture payment system within platform
description: New requirement: Handle furniture payment transactions within tsumugi platform (similar to Mercari). Prevents cash handover, enables transaction tracking, allows platform fees. Separate from property rent payment.
